title: Wrangel Island: the last woolly mammoths
summary: Wrangel Island, off Siberia, was the last refuge of the woolly mammoth. After rising seas cut the island off, a population descended from fewer than ten animals recovered to about 300 breeding individuals and lasted some 6,000 years, dying out around 4,000 years ago. Genomes from 21 mammoths show inbreeding, but the population stayed stable until a rapid, unexplained collapse.

uncertainty.note: Extinction "some 4,000 years ago" and survival "another 6,000 years" are rounded figures; the start is derived from these.

as_recorded.value: What eventually caused the extinction of the Wrangel population some 4,000 years ago remains a mystery
